Primary Function: Sanitizes PDF text layer, strips hidden text & prompt injections.
Extracts candidate skills, job titles, years of experience, and degrees.
Strips demographic proxies (gendered names, graduation dates, zip codes).
Generates 768-dimensional embeddings of candidate skills vs job requirements.
Outputs composite score ($0.00 - 100.00$) and quantile ranking.
Enforces 2-minute mandatory review time lock & blind skill evaluation.
